purpose: Check whether native Ollama tool calling yields a valid first read-only action on new development questions. This is not held-out answer quality evidence.

cases.goal: 在候选资料中，Consecutive Frame 的 PCI 字节 21 低四位表示什么？
请从这个项目报告读取 ECUC 阶段的状态，并指出状态来源。

assessment: One first-action native tool call per case. Valid means exactly one registered tool call with only a nonempty query argument and measured usage; no answer quality score, no repair or rerun.
